attribution.contribution_references_scope: Latest selected family only. Contribution IDs/dates do not identify older differently hashed artwork.
attribution.method: Author names were independently compared against dated official API metadata for every selected family; names agree. Recorded compact contribution IDs/date references are from 26.3 only. No pixel-to-contribution-identity verification is claimed.

legacy_compatibility.method: Reuse the pinned original Faithful artwork through version-appropriate item models and overlays.

legacy_faithful_sources.source_policy: Newest official published exact-client exports checked; only differing original artwork retained. Identical texture files are shared across source families.

early.license: Archive contains an official license URL, not an embedded historical license version; see Legacy-Faithful-64x-links.txt.
